description: A visitor can learn what the application does from the homepage before signing in.
steps: Open the site's root URL (/) in a browser session with no signed-in user.
Verify that the homepage loads and its explanation is visible without signing in.
Verify that the explanation identifies the task the application helps users perform and the outcome users can expect.

description: A new user can create a candidate profile.
steps: Start with a signed-in user who has no candidate profile.
Complete and submit the profile form with valid details.
Reload the profile and verify it shows the details just submitted.

description: A candidate can upload a CV and view the details extracted from it.
steps: Sign in with a candidate profile and upload a supported CV with a known skill and experience entry.
View the extraction result and verify it shows the skill and experience present in the CV.

description: A candidate can provide the job description they are preparing for.
steps: Sign in with a candidate profile and submit a job description with a known role title and requirement.
Verify the submitted role and requirement are available for comparison with the candidate's CV.

description: A candidate can see how their CV matches their target job.
steps: Use a CV that demonstrates one job requirement and omits another.
Run the comparison against the submitted job description.
Verify the result displays a CV-fit score, cites evidence for the matched requirement, and flags the omitted requirement as a gap in the CV.

description: A candidate can see actionable CV improvements tied to the target job.
steps: Open a comparison with a flagged gap and a relevant experience entry that could be clearer.
Request CV improvements and verify the feedback identifies what to change and which job requirement it addresses.
Verify any suggested wording uses facts supported by the candidate's CV or profile.

description: A candidate can complete an assessment tailored to the target role and receive a score.
steps: Start an assessment for a submitted job description with a known requirement.
Verify that at least one assessment item evaluates that requirement, then submit responses.
Verify the result shows an assessment score and identifies an area to improve when a response falls short.

description: A candidate can practice weak areas and repeat the assessment until the readiness criteria are met.
steps: Complete an assessment that falls below the readiness criteria.
Verify that the site provides practice for a weak area and a way to take another assessment.
Submit another below-criteria attempt and verify that the practice and reassessment cycle remains available.
Submit an attempt that meets the criteria and verify that the site reports readiness for the selected role.
